name: Fontainebleau Las Vegas
positioning: A MICHELIN Key resort and casino on the north end of the Las Vegas Strip, with a six-acre pool complex, a spa and a sports memorabilia museum
best_for: Travelers attending events at the Las Vegas Convention Center
Guests who want a big pool scene with a daylife club
Spa and wellness-minded stays on the Strip

facts.text: Fontainebleau Las Vegas sits on the north end of the Las Vegas Strip.
The resort is less than a 20-minute ride from Harry Reid International Airport.
The resort is a 10-minute walk from the Las Vegas Convention Center.
The resort has a station on the Vegas Loop, an underground transit system powered by Tesla vehicles, which reaches all Las Vegas Convention Center terminals.
Fontainebleau Las Vegas was honored with One MICHELIN Key for a second year in 2026.
The Legacy Pool is a secluded pool reserved for guests 21 and over.
The wellness offering includes the spa, a fitness center, the NutriDrip IV Drip Lounge, IGK Salon and a nail lounge.
Gold rooms have Strip, mountain or pool views.
Some Fleur de Lis suites include an in-suite wellness room.
The Hall of Excellence's Trophy Room features the Vince Lombardi Trophy, the Heisman Trophy and the Claret Jug.
BleauLive Theater has three levels and cutting-edge audiovisual technology.
Ito is an omakase restaurant on the top floor serving fish flown in daily from Japan to 12 guests per seating.

highlights.text: The six-acre Oasis Pool includes LIV Beach, a daylife destination.
The Hall of Excellence is a memorabilia museum curated by Tom Brady and sportscaster Jim Gray.
Lapis Spa & Wellness offers signature treatments such as hydrotherapy and an Event Sauna.
LIV Beach hosts headlining performers such as Tiesto and John Summit, with VIP daybeds, cabanas and villa cabanas in an ambiance reminiscent of the French Riviera.
The fitness center has wall-to-wall windows overlooking the Strip.

considerations.text: There is a resort fee; self-parking for hotel guests is included in it for their stay.
Valet validation is not available to registered hotel guests.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing for this newer luxury property.
